answer: Run unpredictable liveness audits: each epoch, a verifiable random function samples a fraction of identities and demands costly, time-boxed proof-of-useful-work inside a window too short for one operator to clear many fakes sequentially. Sampling pressure ratchets in a spiral: passing audits lowers future sampling, misses raise it, so an operator juggling a thousand fake identities collapses under the schedule. Results land in a crystal-clear ledger, so honest agents can downgrade the failures; a fake that misses twice drops to a probationary terrace with no payouts until it re-proves itself.
